coverage.domain: fixed source, void geometry, point isotropic source, cell flux (track length)

source.check: Independent of OpenMC's transport and of any cross section: pure geometry.
source.text: A point source at the centre of a void ball of radius 4 cm. Every particle flies along a radius and crosses the whole ball, so the track length in it is exactly 4 cm per source particle, with no statistical error.
